summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 optimization features for VPOS/MPOS quote flow. All 8 test requirements verified: 1) Client search filters by name and RIF only (not sucursal), placeholder correct 2) Item #4 has editable Bancos field with Auto/Manual badges 3) Total auto-recalculates when Bancos changed 4) Duplicate preserves autoBancos behavior 5) Cliente en Producción section visible after recurring costs 6) Clicking Sí reveals dropdown with Agregar button 7) Production items have editable Cajas/Bancos/Tarifa with auto-calculated Total 8) Production items contribute to total recurring.

issues: React hydration warnings (cosmetic) - tr inside span, span inside tbody - caused by Emergent Visual Editor wrapper
